# Coverage

> A mapping aid for engineers, architects and auditors. It records which controls have checked evidence in which repository and where there are gaps. It is not legal advice, not a conformity assessment and not a statement that any system complies with anything.

| **All** | **41** | **6** | **22** | **2** | **10** | **1** |

## What the statuses mean

- **implemented**: A working technical control exists in code, tests or configuration.
- **partial**: Some of what the control asks for exists; the limits say what is missing.
- **designed**: A design or decision is documented; no running implementation in these repositories.
- **organisational**: Needs people, policy or a legal decision that no repository can show. Supporting evidence may be listed.
- **gap**: Applicable, and nothing here addresses it.

_Article numbers and subjects only; each summary is a paraphrase written for this pack, not the legal text. High-risk obligations apply from 2 December 2027 (Annex III) and 2 August 2028 (Annex I) after the Digital Omnibus on AI; see docs/regulatory-status.md.
